title: Paul Éluard's mantis collection and Caillois' mantis folklore research

tellings.quote: One of his friends, Paul Elard, another of the founding surrealists, had this insane manted collection in his home.

plain: The French poet Paul Éluard, one of the founders of surrealism, an art movement built on dreams and the unconscious, kept a huge collection of praying mantises in his home. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this on the show without naming a source, linking it to Éluard's friend, the writer Roger Caillois, who studied folklore about the mantis. Jorjani brings it up as a sign that these early surrealists were deeply taken with the mantis.
